meta.title: Portal access | Invessiv
meta.description: Confirm your access to the customer portal.

page.title: Your access is ready.
page.body: Sign in or create an account to activate the one-time access for your company.
page.invalid: This access link is no longer valid. Please ask your project team for a new link.
page.expired: This access link has expired. Please ask your project team for a new link.
page.redeemed: This access link has already been used. Sign in with the account that activated access.
page.unavailable: Access cannot be activated right now. Please try again later.
page.storageNote: Good to know: so unfinished messages aren’t lost, the portal keeps drafts and unsent messages in your browser’s local storage. They stay on your device and are removed once sent.
